s: When Mr. Sloan drew a ______ on the blackboard, the students thought he was writing the letter O.【103年特招】
o: circle
line
point
square
e: 當Mr. Sloan在黑板上畫一個「圓」，學生認為他是在寫字母O。故選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)線(Ｃ)點(Ｄ)方形。

s: Excuse me, but I just can't ______ your dress.  It's beautiful.  Where did you buy it?【103年特招】
o: do anything about
pay for
stop looking at
think about
e: 不好意思，我就是無法「停止注視」妳的洋裝。它好美。妳在哪裡買的呢？故選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)做任何關於(Ｂ)付錢買(Ｄ)思考。

s: In the race, the girl was so far ______ that no one was fast enough to run past her.【103年特招】
o: ahead
along
around
before
e: 在比賽中，這個女孩遙遙「領先」以致於沒人可以跑超越她。故選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)沿著(Ｃ)周圍(Ｄ)以前。

s: Nobody thinks it is ______ to build a new sports center in six months.  But Ms. Chaplin believes she can do it.【103年特招】
o: dangerous
difficult
possible
useful
e: 沒有人認為在六個月內蓋一座新的運動中心是「可能的」。但Chaplin女士則相信她可以做到。故選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)危險的(Ｂ)困難的(Ｄ)有用的。

s: Although it's been forty years, Grandpa Wan ______ clearly how much it hurt to leave his hometown for Taiwan all by himself.  He has told us the story many times.【103年特招】
o: will remember
had remembered
remembered
remembers
e: 雖然已經四十年了，Grandpa Wan依舊記得很清楚當初獨自離開家鄉來臺灣有多痛。他已經告訴我們這個故事很多次了。由時態使用現在完成式可知是到現在仍記得，所以用現在簡單式remembers，故選(Ｄ)。

s: Janice paints pictures as beautiful as those in art museums, but she's never thought about making money from it.  She only does it ______.【103年特招】
o: for business
for fun
for life
for once
e: Janice畫圖畫得跟在美術館裡的圖一樣美麗，但她從未想過從中賺錢，她只是「為了樂趣」而畫。故選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)為了工作(Ｃ)為了生活(Ｄ)僅此一次。

s: Everyone in the town feels strange that all the cows at Mr. White's farm died in one night.  ______ has never been anything like this before.【103年特招】
o: He
It
That
There
e: 鎮裡的每個人都覺得Mr. White農場所有的牛一夜死去很奇怪。以前從來沒「有」像這樣的事發生過。表示事實狀態的存在的「有」，用there＋be動詞，故選(Ｄ)。

s: Dino: Do you have any stamps?  Emma: Yes, just go to my desk.  I put ______ in my pencil case in the second drawer.【103年特招】
o: ones
others
some
those
e:
Dino: 妳有沒有郵票？
Emma:有，去我桌子拿。我放了「一些」在第二個抽屜的鉛筆盒裡。
由上下文可知應選some這個不定代名詞，故選(Ｃ)。

s: Mia: Is it OK if I keep this photo?  Lynn: ______  I have another copy.【103年特招】
o: Sorry, no.
No, I'm not sure.
Yes, that's fine.
Yes, I'll see what I can do.
e:
Mia: 如果我留著這張照片，這樣可以嗎？
Lynn:「可以，沒關係。」我還有另一張相同的。
由上下文可知應選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)抱歉，不行。(Ｂ)不，我不確定。(Ｄ)可以，我會看我能做什麼。

s: (１)What can we learn from the reading?
p: 【103年特招】
o: Gordon didn't eat lunch at school these days.
Gordon didn't like the dinner his mother prepared for him.
Gordon's mother told him to study in the library after school.
Gordon's mother made the “Saving Gordon” plan for his health.
e: 由第二段第三句可知Gordon媽媽替他準備全蔬菜晚餐，而他因不喜歡才想出「拯救Gordon」計畫，找藉口不回家吃晚餐，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (２)From what the doctor said, which is NOT the right meal for Gordon?
p: 【103年特招】
e:
由倒數第二句可知，Gordon唯一能吃的肉類是魚，所以D餐中有豬肉是不合適的，故選(Ｄ)。
中譯：　　Gordon今天在體育課的一場賽跑中昏倒了。我們帶他去健康中心並請醫生對他進行檢查。結果Gordon會昏倒是因為他太胖了。
　　Gordon沒肉就活不了。對他而言，沒肉的餐點是給兔子或羊吃的、不是給人吃的。所以在他媽媽開始為了他的健康而準備全蔬菜晚餐後的兩週，他想到這個「拯救Gordon」計畫。他告訴他媽媽他晚餐不會回家吃因為他必須在圖書館讀書讀到很晚。這就是Gordon如何還能每天吃到「很多肉的」晚餐。這個計畫最後導致他進入了健康中心。醫生要求Gordon開始多吃蔬菜跟做少量運動，因為他的體重已經對心臟造成負擔。唯一他應該吃的肉類是魚肉。身為Gordon的好朋友，我已經決定明天帶給他「綠色」中餐了！

s: (１)What can we learn about Joseph and Angela?
p:
Joseph: You heard about Charlotte's orchard?
Angela: Yes. She left it to her only grandson.
Joseph: Crazy idea to leave her orchard to a city boy. Her apple trees will grow better without him.
Angela: Oh, you and your mouth! You haven't even met Phillip yet.
Joseph: Phillip? So you've already seen him? I don't like him already just hearing the name.
Angela: Well, I stopped by Charlotte's house this morning. They moved in yesterday.
Joseph: They?
Angela: Oh, Phillip and his little girl Nina. You see, Charlotte was our dear old friend. When she was in the hospital, all she cared about was Phillip. Now she's gone; we should at least do something to help her family.
Joseph: A man with a child and an orchard to take care of ? I give him three months. In three months' time, the apple trees will all die and he'll move back to the city.
Angela: Don't be like that! Phillip looks like a smart man. I think he'll do just fine.
Joseph: Well, you just wait.

【103年特招】
o: They have different ideas about Phillip.
They did not know Charlotte for very long.
They worked together in Charlotte's orchard.
They have decided to take care of Phillip's daughter.
e: 由對話中可知Joseph認為把果園交給都市人是很瘋狂的，後面也提到Joseph覺得三個月後蘋果樹就會死，Phillip就會搬回都市；但Angela則認為，Phillip看起來像聰明人，可以做得很好，兩個人的看法截然不同，故選(Ａ)。

p:
Joseph: You heard about Charlotte's orchard?
Angela: Yes. She left it to her only grandson.
Joseph: Crazy idea to leave her orchard to a city boy. Her apple trees will grow better without him.
Angela: Oh, you and your mouth! You haven't even met Phillip yet.
Joseph: Phillip? So you've already seen him? I don't like him already just hearing the name.
Angela: Well, I stopped by Charlotte's house this morning. They moved in yesterday.
Joseph: They?
Angela: Oh, Phillip and his little girl Nina. You see, Charlotte was our dear old friend. When she was in the hospital, all she cared about was Phillip. Now she's gone; we should at least do something to help her family.
Joseph: A man with a child and an orchard to take care of ? I give him three months. In three months' time, the apple trees will all die and he'll move back to the city.
Angela: Don't be like that! Phillip looks like a smart man. I think he'll do just fine.
Joseph: Well, you just wait.

【103年特招】
o: He has experience in growing apple trees.
He wants to move back to the city in three months.
He now stays in Charlotte's house with his daughter.
He often visited Charlotte when she was in the hospital.
e: 由對話中可知(Ａ)Phillip是都市人，所以無種蘋果樹經驗(Ｂ)是Joseph認為Phillip三個月後就會搬走(Ｃ)Phillip和他女兒現在住在Charlotte的房子(Ｄ)未提及Phillip是否有去醫院看Charlotte。故只有(Ｃ)正確。

s: (３)Why did Joseph say “Well, you just wait”?
p:
Joseph: You heard about Charlotte's orchard?
Angela: Yes. She left it to her only grandson.
Joseph: Crazy idea to leave her orchard to a city boy. Her apple trees will grow better without him.
Angela: Oh, you and your mouth! You haven't even met Phillip yet.
Joseph: Phillip? So you've already seen him? I don't like him already just hearing the name.
Angela: Well, I stopped by Charlotte's house this morning. They moved in yesterday.
Joseph: They?
Angela: Oh, Phillip and his little girl Nina. You see, Charlotte was our dear old friend. When she was in the hospital, all she cared about was Phillip. Now she's gone; we should at least do something to help her family.
Joseph: A man with a child and an orchard to take care of ? I give him three months. In three months' time, the apple trees will all die and he'll move back to the city.
Angela: Don't be like that! Phillip looks like a smart man. I think he'll do just fine.
Joseph: Well, you just wait.

【103年特招】
o: He saw no hope for Charlotte's orchard.
He showed no interest in growing apple trees.
He did not care who would get Charlotte's orchard.
He did not like the way Charlotte grew her apple trees.
e:
因Joseph認為Phillip是都市人，不能管理好果園，才會說「好，妳等著看吧」。故選(Ａ)他對Charlotte的果園感到無望。
中譯：Joseph：妳聽說Charlotte的果園了嗎？
Angela：有啊。她把它留給她唯一的孫子。
Joseph：把她的果園留給一個都市孩子真是個瘋狂的想法。她的蘋果樹沒有他應該會長得更好。
Angela：噢，你跟你的嘴！你甚至還沒見過Phillip。
Joseph：Phillip？所以妳已經見過他了？我光是聽他的名字就已經不喜歡他了。
Angela：嗯，我今天早上拜訪了Charlotte家。他們昨天搬進去了。
Joseph：他們？
Angela：噢，Phillip跟他的小女兒Nina。你知道的，Charlotte是我們親愛的老朋友。當她在醫院時，她所關心的都是Phillip。現在她走了；我們應該至少做些什麼來幫助她的家人。
Joseph：一個男人帶著小孩還有一個果園要照顧？我給他三個月。三個月內，蘋果樹就會全部死光，然後他就會搬回都市去。
Angela：不要這樣！Phillip看起來像個聰明人。我想他會做得不錯的。
Joseph：好，妳就等著看吧。

s: (１)What can be learned from the news?
p:
Read the news of a typhoon and answer the questions.
August 15
A small but fast-growing typhoon is seen near Star Island. We're not sure if it will come straight to Cruk Island but we'll keep watching.
…
August 19
Typhoon Candice is growing stronger west of Star Island. We can see a clear eye in its center, which tells us its winds are very strong. The typhoon will hit Cruk Island in four days if it keeps heading northeast.
…
August 22
Candice is moving faster than we thought. It will arrive at Cruk Island around 4:00 this afternoon. Kos will be the first town to be hit. Please stay prepared.
August 23
Candice has been on a slow move since it hit the island at 3:30 yesterday afternoon. Its eye can still be clearly seen, and heavy rains will stay around for a few more days. Luckily, the wind is not as strong as Tiger in July.
…
August 27
Three days after leaving the island, Candice has turned back. It will hit again in two days. This time, Haz will be the first to face it.

【103年特招】
o: The news gave the number of missing people.
The rains Candice brought helped Cruk Island a lot.
Candice is the first typhoon to hit Cruk Island this year.
Cruk Island is going to face another attack from Candice.
e: 由報導內容可知8/22Candice颱風將從Kos侵襲Cruk島，8/27又迴轉由Haz再度登陸，故選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)未提及失蹤人數(Ｂ)未提及雨量是否有幫助(Ｃ)8/23的報導有提到七月有個Tiger颱風，所以Candice並非第一個颱風。

p:

e:
由連日報導可知，Candice一開始8/19朝東北前進，然後由Kos侵襲Cruk島，接著8/27又迴轉由Haz再度登陸，由敘述路線可知應選(Ｄ)。
中譯：看颱風新聞並回答問題。
8月15日
在Star島附近有個小但快速發展的颱風形成。我們不確定它是否會直接往Cruk島來，但我們會持續注意。
8月19日
颱風Candice正在Star島西方增強中。我們可以看見它中心有個清楚的颱風眼，這就告訴我們它的風非常強勁。如果颱風持續朝東北方前進，它將會在四天後侵襲Cruk島。
8月22日
Candice比我們想的還快速地正在移動中。它將會在今天下午大約4點抵達Cruk島。Kos將會是第一個被侵襲的城鎮。請做好準備。
8月23日
Candice自從昨天下午3點半侵襲Cruk島後，已經慢了下來。它的颱風眼依舊清晰可見，而且大雨將在接下來幾天持續著。幸運地，風勢沒有七月的Tiger颱風強。
8月27日
在離開Cruk島三天後，Candice又轉回來了。它將會在兩天後再度侵襲。這一次，Haz將會首當其衝。

s: (１)What does provenance mean in the reading?
p:
How do you choose a T-shirt when you're shopping? Its price, its brand, what it is made of, or how it looks on you? Have you ever thought what it may take to make a T-shirt?
　　When people hear about clothes factory workers in poor countries working day and night on little pay, they feel worried if their clothes are from factories of this kind. They begin to ask about how and where their clothes are made, and who makes them. The provenance of clothes has now become an important fact shoppers ask for.
　　Some brands of clothes have listened and started to move their factories back to their home countries. There the cost of making clothes is higher, but the workers are better paid and taken good care of. Clothes of these brands are more expensive, but people don't mind paying a little more to feel right. Today these brands have even become leaders in the business.
　　Next time you are buying a T-shirt that feels good on your body, you may want to learn its story and see if it also feels good in your heart.

【103年特招】
o: The story of making something popular.
The story behind the making of something.
The way of taking care of something expensive.
The way of cutting the cost of making something.
e: 由前面提到消費者開始問所購買的衣服是如何製造、在哪裡製造、是誰製造的，可知道provenance的意思為「製造商品背後的故事」，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (２)Why did some brands of clothes move their factories back to their home countries?
p:
How do you choose a T-shirt when you're shopping? Its price, its brand, what it is made of, or how it looks on you? Have you ever thought what it may take to make a T-shirt?
　　When people hear about clothes factory workers in poor countries working day and night on little pay, they feel worried if their clothes are from factories of this kind. They begin to ask about how and where their clothes are made, and who makes them. The provenance of clothes has now become an important fact shoppers ask for.
　　Some brands of clothes have listened and started to move their factories back to their home countries. There the cost of making clothes is higher, but the workers are better paid and taken good care of. Clothes of these brands are more expensive, but people don't mind paying a little more to feel right. Today these brands have even become leaders in the business.
　　Next time you are buying a T-shirt that feels good on your body, you may want to learn its story and see if it also feels good in your heart.

【103年特招】
o: Their workers in poor countries started to ask for more pay.
They tried to answer what shoppers of their clothes cared about.
They had trouble following the rules on opening a factory in foreign lands.
Their clothes have sold better in their home countries than in foreign lands.
e: 第二段的最後一句，提到衣服的製造過程現在已經變成消費者很在意的因素，第三段的第一句提到許多衣服廠牌聽到這樣的聲音，所以把工廠遷回自己的家鄉，故選(Ｂ)他們試著回應買衣服者所在意的因素。

s: (３)Which idea is talked about in the reading?
p:
How do you choose a T-shirt when you're shopping? Its price, its brand, what it is made of, or how it looks on you? Have you ever thought what it may take to make a T-shirt?
　　When people hear about clothes factory workers in poor countries working day and night on little pay, they feel worried if their clothes are from factories of this kind. They begin to ask about how and where their clothes are made, and who makes them. The provenance of clothes has now become an important fact shoppers ask for.
　　Some brands of clothes have listened and started to move their factories back to their home countries. There the cost of making clothes is higher, but the workers are better paid and taken good care of. Clothes of these brands are more expensive, but people don't mind paying a little more to feel right. Today these brands have even become leaders in the business.
　　Next time you are buying a T-shirt that feels good on your body, you may want to learn its story and see if it also feels good in your heart.

【103年特招】
o: Shoppers care about more than just the price of their clothes.
It has become less and less safe to open factories in poor countries.
People feel better and safer to wear clothes that are made from plants.
Workers in poor countries cannot find jobs when factories keep moving out.
e:
整篇文章提到的是現在消費者所在意的不只是價格，而是產品背後的製造過程跟故事，故選(Ａ)消費者在意不只是衣服的價格而已。
中譯：　　當你購物時，你是如何選擇T恤呢？它的價格、它的品牌、它是如何製作的、或是它穿在你身上看起來如何？你是否曾想過製作一件T恤可能伴隨著什麼？
　　當人們聽說在貧窮國家的衣服工廠員工是日夜工作但卻領很少的錢時，他們會因為從這樣的工廠所製作出來的衣服而感到擔心。他們開始會問他們的衣服是如何製作、哪裡製作以及是誰製作的。衣服的起源現在已經變成消費者要求的重要事實。
　　一些衣服的品牌已經聽見這樣的聲音並開始把他們的工廠遷回家鄉。在那裡製作衣服的成本比較高，但是員工會得到較好的待遇跟照顧。這些品牌的衣服是比較昂貴的，但人們不介意付多一點錢來讓自己覺得是對的。今天這些品牌甚至已經成為領導品牌。
　　下次當你買一件覺得穿在自己身上很好看的T恤，你可能會想知道它的故事並看看是否在你心裡也覺得很舒適。

s: (１)From the reading, what can we learn about Friday Night Skate?
p: 【103年特招】
o: The fight between the city and roller skaters.
Roller skaters' ideas about the roller skating police.
The new plans the city has made for Friday Night Skate.
The changes Friday Night Skate brings to some people's life.
e: 由內容裡四個人提到對Friday Night Skate的看法，Roy覺得這是很好的活動，但希望可以更進一步希望有特別步道給溜直排輪者；Ian則覺得溜直排輪者太吵；Ursula也覺得這活動帶來垃圾跟噪音；Zoe則覺得溜直排輪者跟行人會互相干擾，希望政府可以改善。所以此題應選(Ｄ)Friday Night Skate帶給一些人生活上的改變。

s:
(２)Below you will find some words from a newspaper story about Friday Night Skate.

Who will most likely feel ANGRY about the news?
p: 【103年特招】
o: Roy and Ian.
Ian and Ursula.
Ursula and Zoe.
Roy and Zoe.
e: 題目裡的報紙內容提到「自從Friday Night Skate開始之後，溜直排輪的人數成長中」、「政府已經同意開發在其他天晚上也開放道路」，而文章中覺得這活動很吵會帶來髒亂的人是Ian跟Ursula，所以他們兩個是最可能生氣這樣政策的人，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (３)Below is what Roy found about roller skating accidents in four different studies. Which agrees with his idea?
p: 【103年特招】
e:
Roy在文章中提到希望政府可以開放特別的溜直排輪步道，這樣才不會有交通事故，以下四個圖只有(Ｄ)直排輪步道的數量增加；意外事故減少。這個符合Roy的想法。
中譯：一週精選
每週五晚上，人們在市中心聚集溜直排輪，而且他們組成一條10哩的行列！甚至連警方都溜直排輪。他們穿著直排輪來協助溜直排輪者。你對於週五夜溜有何看法？告訴我們。
Roy寫到：
　　我從沒錯過這個活動。我的意思是這是我唯一可以在路上溜直排輪而不用擔心我可能會被車撞的機會。我玩得很開心。但是我還是希望將來能夠有一條專用路徑給溜直排輪的人。
Ian寫到：
　　自從這個直排輪活動開始，我就沒辦法在每星期五睡個好覺。這些溜直排輪者在溜過我公寓前的時候大喊大叫跟唱歌。如果他們唱得好就算了，但他們「不是」！
Ursula寫到：
　　週五夜溜帶來了噪音跟垃圾，並且讓我想要搬走！
Zoe寫到：
　　這個城市必須思考這些溜直排輪者應該在哪裡溜。當溜直排輪者在路上溜時，可能很容易就會被撞，但他們在人行道上溜時則很可能撞到人。這城市在每週五晚上開放道路給溜直排輪者是好的，但這只能解決部分問題。

s: (１)What is Ruby's report most likely about?
p:
Ruby wrote a report last week. Below are some facts in her report.




【103年特招】
o: A language changes when its speakers change their way of thinking.
Speakers of different languages may see the world in different ways.
A good way to learn a language is to live in the country where it is spoken.
People who speak the same language may still fail to understand each other.
e: Ruby這個報告裡提到三個關於語言的事實，一個是西班牙文跟德文對於物品會賦予性別的差異；一個是在澳洲有種語言Kuuk Thaayorre對於左邊、右邊、後面是沒有字可以表達的；一個是在俄文中對顏色的區分比一般語言多，是別種語言者難以感受的。因此我們可以知道Ruby的報告是關於(Ｂ)不同語言的使用者會用不同的方式看世界。

s: (２)What do we learn from the reading?
p:
Ruby wrote a report last week. Below are some facts in her report.




【103年特招】
o: Blue is one of Russian people's favorite colors.
For English speakers, Russian is easier to learn than Kuuk Thaayorre.
Most people who live in Pormpuraaw are able to speak more than one language.
It is hard for a Kuuk Thaayorre speaker to know what “A dog is on your right” means.
e: 由文章內容可知Kuuk Thaayorre這種語言的使用者，沒有左邊、右邊、後面的說法，所以他們很難理解「一隻狗在你右邊」的意思是什麼，故選(Ｄ)。其他(Ａ)(Ｂ)(Ｃ)在內容均無提到。

s:
(３)Here is another fact in Ruby's report.

From Fact 4 and Fact 1, which is most likely true?
p:
Ruby wrote a report last week. Below are some facts in her report.




【103年特招】
o: Like German speaker, French speakers might think of a chair as “pretty.”
Like Spanish speakers, French speakers might think of a bridge as “pretty.”
Like German speakers, French speakers might think of a chair as “strong.”
Like Spanish speakers, French speakers might think of a bridge as “strong.”
e:
題目中的事實四提到，法文對不同東西也會賦予性別，法文中，橋是公的，椅子是母的，跟西班牙文一樣；不過西班牙文中，叉子是公的，法文中叉子是母的，又跟西班文相反，反而跟德文一樣。所以可知「橋」在法文跟西班牙文是公的，在德文是母的；「椅子」在法文跟西班牙文是母的，在德文是公的。故選(Ｄ)像說西班牙文的人一樣，法國人可能也覺得橋是強壯的。
中譯：Ruby上週寫了一份報告。以下是她報告中的一些事實。
事實一：在英文中，我們使用代名詞它來稱呼橋、椅子或任何沒生命的東西。但在西班牙文中，人們使用代名詞él（他）來代表橋而ella（她）來代表椅子；然而在德文中，橋的代名詞為sie（她）而椅子為er（他）。當他們被問到他們是如何想橋的時候，說西班牙文者認為它是「強壯的」，而說德文者則認為它是「美麗的」。
事實二：Kuuk Thaayorre是一種在澳洲Pormpuraaw這地方所說的語言。這個語言沒有字可以表示「左邊」、「右邊」跟「後面」。當說Kuuk Thaayorre語的人需要表達東西在哪裡時，他們將會像這樣子表達「有一條蛇在你南方」或「這個杯子在這個碗的西南方」。說Kuuk Thaayorre語的人總是有辦法分辨東西南北，即使是從沒到過的地方。住在Pormpuraaw但不會說Kuuk Thaayorre語的人就沒那麼擅長分辨東西到底在哪裡。
事實三：在俄文中，有不同的字表示不同的藍，像goluboy(淺藍色)跟siniy(深藍色)。說俄文者可以很快分辨哪個顏色是goluboy哪個顏色是siniy。然而，對說英文者而言，兩種顏色都被稱作blue，而且他們需要多點時間才能分辨兩種藍的不同。

s: (１)What do we know about the book Gone and Away?
p: 【103年特招】
o: It just came out last week.
It is the darkest book Steinberg ever wrote.
It has interested people in the movie business.
It was written to remember Steinberg's country.
e: 由第二段第三句提到Steinberg的書有六本已經翻拍成電影，而且每一部都成為當年度最賣座的電影。但Steinberg卻還沒同意電影商翻拍Gone and Away，可知道這本書已經讓電影商很有興趣，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (２)What does the reading say about Steinberg?
p: 【103年特招】
o: He is also good at making movies.
He spent his younger days abroad.
He has written more than six books.
He will be interviewed by City Daily.
e: 由第二段第三句提到Steinberg的書有六本已經翻拍成電影，所以可以知道他所寫的書是超過六本的，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (３)What does a critically acclaimed book mean?
p: 【103年特招】
o: A book which is made into a movie.
A book which is loved and taken seriously.
A book which sells better abroad than at home.
A book which tells a true story in a different way.
e: 由第二段第一句提到Gone and Away這本書自從問世後，無論是他家鄉或海外，已經贏得許多作品大獎，可推知critically acclaimed的意思為被喜愛且被認真看待跟討論，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (４)What does he had not seen Aaron in any actor yet mean?
p: 【103年特招】
o: Steinberg did not find the right actor to play Aaron.
Steinberg did not see the actor named Aaron for a long time.
Steinberg did not like the actors who had played Aaron well.
Steinberg could not find any actor who wanted to play Aaron.
e:
由第二段中最後一句可知Steinberg一直未答應電影商拍Gone and Away是因為他還沒在任何演員中看到書中主角Aaron的影子，所以可推知he had not seen Aaron in any actor yet的意思為(Ａ)Steinberg還沒找到適合的演員來扮演Aaron。
中譯：　　自從Steinberg上個禮拜在他的訪問當中說他想看到Gone and Away搬上大銀幕時，網路已經充滿關於誰應該扮演Aaron的討論，這個他所有書中最黑暗卻也最被喜愛的角色。
　　Gone and Away是Steinberg最受到讚揚的書，而這本書自從問世後也已經贏得許多大獎，不論在他家鄉還是海外。去年它被國家最大的報紙City Daily列為史上前十大好書的其中一本。Steinberg的書有六本已經被翻拍成電影，且每一部都成為當年度最賣座的電影。然而Steinberg從未對那些想拍攝Gone and Away成電影的人點頭說好。很多人猜測可能是因為Aaron其實就是Steinberg他年輕時的自己。當人們問起時，Steinberg只是說他還沒在任何演員中看到Aaron的影子。
　　是否Steinberg最後在心中已經有名單了呢？那個人是誰？想知道更多關於Steinberg跟Gone and Away的人，請別錯過今晚九點的Book Hour。

p:
When Andy came to school, he was surprised to find he was the first to arrive that day. “Where is Susie?” he thought. In all Andy's elementary school life, Susie (1) later than him. She was the smartest student in the class and was always the earliest to class. Andy was always the second smartest and the second earliest.
In class, Andy learned that Susie went to visit her grandma in London and that she (2) back until Friday. Andy was happy and sad at the same time. He was happy because he (3) the smartest kid and also the earliest to class for four days. He was sad because he could not see Susie, the girl he was secretly in love with.
Over the following days, Andy felt bad about being the smartest kid and the earliest to class. It was like he was taking something that was not his.
Finally, Friday (4) . When Andy entered the classroom, he found Susie was already there. At that moment he decided one thing. Susie was the smartest girl in the class, and he was the smartest boy in the class. And that was enough.


【103年特招】
o: had never been
was never going to be
has never been
is never
e: 由一開始的時態用的是過去式的came、was surprised、thought…可知整篇是在敘述過去的事件，因此這裡的時態應該是過去完成式，「在Andy的國小生活中，Susie從沒比他晚到過」，故選(Ａ)。

Finally, Friday (4) . When Andy entered the classroom, he found Susie was already there. At that moment he decided one thing. Susie was the smartest girl in the class, and he was the smartest boy in the class. And that was enough.

e:
「最後，星期五到了。」以文章敘述可知也是過去的事了，故使用came即可。故選(Ａ)。
中譯：　　當Andy來學校時，他很驚訝地發現那天他是最早到的人。他心想「Susie在哪兒呢？」在Andy的小學生活中，Susie從未比他晚到。她是班上最聰明的學生，而且總是最早到班上。Andy總是第二聰明的也是第二早到的。
　　在課堂上，Andy知道Susie去倫敦拜訪祖母而且直到星期五才會回來。Andy一方面開心一方面難過。他開心是因為接下來這四天他將是班上最聰明的孩子也會最早到班上。他難過是因為他就無法看到他偷偷喜歡的女生Susie。
　　在接下來的日子裡，Andy對於當最聰明的孩子跟最早到的人感到糟糕。這種感覺就像他佔據著不屬於他的東西。
　　最後，星期五來了。當Andy進入教室時，他發現Susie已經在那裡。那一瞬間他決定了一件事：Susie是班上最聰明的女孩，而他是班上最聰明的男孩。那就夠了。

p: 【103年特招】
o: very little was known about it
it had been found in other countries
few thought it would be any trouble
the world started to find answers to it
e: 由前一句說「在1981年，當AIDS第一次在美國被報導」跟下一句「當時甚至沒名字」，可推知應為「當時關於它的資訊非常少」，故選(Ａ)。

p: 【103年特招】
o: their worries did not come true; hope did
wrong ideas can't hurt us; wrong actions can
old rules can't change the world; new ideas can
AIDS did not bring the end of the world; fear did
e: 前一段的最後一句說到「有些人甚至覺得AIDS會帶來世界末日」，這段一開始用了However來轉折語氣，後面還提到「在1995年，臺裔美國人何大一找到幫助AIDS患者的方法」可知這裡應該選(Ａ)他們的擔心沒成真，反而是希望出現。

p: 【103年特招】
o: have a lot of stories to tell
have a much brighter future
have to learn to help each other
have to spend a lot on medicines
e:
由下一句提到有更強的藥可以讓他們活得更久更好，可推知那些AIDS的患者「有更光明的未來」，故選(Ｂ)。
中譯：CBN新聞
2005 / 7 / 1
　　愛滋病是世界上最嚴重的健康問題之一。在1981年，當愛滋病在美國第一次被報導時，關於它的資訊非常地少。那時它甚至是沒有名字的。沒人知道人們是如何得到它的、沒人知道如何對抗它，而且人們就只是持續因為它而死去。世界是如此害怕愛滋病以致於關於愛滋病的錯誤訊息到處被傳遞。有些人確信只要在愛滋病患週遭就會感染。有些人甚至確信愛滋病會帶來世界末日。
　　然而他們的擔心並沒有成真，取而代之的是希望。在1995年，一個臺裔美國人，何大一，發現了幫助愛滋病患的方法。自那時起，到現在世界已經發現更多更好的方式來對抗愛滋病。死於愛滋病的人數已經明顯下降。愛滋病患者有更光明的未來。有更強的藥可以幫他們活得更久更好。今日，對愛滋病仍沒有簡單的答案，但至少我們知道更多關於它的訊息。現在我們可以用經驗來對抗它，而不是害怕面對它。
